enumeration_contract: Start at requested page 1; reject :page instead of silently ignoring it. Carry filters/sort/per_page into every request.
Stop at returned pagination boundaries, progress using the requested page, and reject malformed/non-advancing metadata instead of looping.
An error on any page returns the error, not a successful partial collection; keep item order and avoid duplicate fetches.
Concatenate rows only when headers and echoed account/date/grouping/sort filters match. Reject mismatches without silently reshaping rows.
Return one Result with first-page headers and query (including its page/per_page as first-request provenance). Do not manufacture aggregate pagination.
